summary: Conservative English apostrophe and contraction repair

changes.title: Fill missing English contractions without replacing dictionaries
changes.detail: Review 66 standard/common apostrophe spellings using the bundled English native dictionary; add only absent forms at conservative fallback frequencies. Preserve original US/UK main dictionaries, n-grams, existing unrelated vocabulary and learned data.

changes.title: Protect ambiguous words and curly apostrophes
changes.detail: Keep ambiguous unpunctuated words from new supplement-driven automatic corrections, preserve manual suggestions, and normalize internal curly apostrophes only for context/model lookup. BR Brain model vocabulary and weights remain unchanged.
